newsitem.title: USA: Checkpoint shares tumble on net warning.
newsitem.headline: Checkpoint shares tumble on net warning.

text.p: Checkpoint Systems Inc shares slid nearly 25 percent in third market activity on Wednesday but remained delayed on the New York Stock Exchange after the company warned third quarter results would be below estimates.

In a statement late Tuesday, Checkpoint said lost manufacturing time due to Hurricane Hortense and delays in product rollouts would push third quarter earnings per share $0.05 to $0.06 below analysts' estimates.
The First Call mean estimate for the quarter was $0.20 per share prior to the announcement.
